summary: Clearway Energy Inc.'s Swan Purchaser LLC signed a Membership Interest Purchase Agreement on September 23, 2026 with Swan CE Seller LLC, an affiliate of Clearway Energy Group. Purchaser will buy membership interests in Swan TargetCo LLC, indirect owner of Swan Solar LLC, for a base cash price of approximately $230 million, subject to financial-model adjustments tied to minimum economic thresholds. Swan Solar is developing a roughly 650 MW solar project in Bates County, Missouri. Post-closing, Purchaser holds 100% Class A units and CEG affiliate Clearway Renew holds 100% Class C units; closing expected third quarter 2028. Watch affiliate-conflict pricing, model true-ups, and financing conditions.
